name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/x402-validate-vs-discovery
title: x402 Validate vs Discovery Checker
description: Checks whether a resource that validates still appears in bazaar discovery.

tools.name: x402-validate-vs-discovery
tools.description: A resource can pass Coinbase CDP validate=true and still be absent from Bazaar discovery until the first real settlement, and it is unclear whether a USDC-on-Base payment also needs ETH for gas. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Calls the official CDP validate endpoint and the discovery lookup for an exact resource URL, reports whether a first settlement is still required, and states that the payer signs EIP-3009 while the facilitator submits and pays gas. An empty call uses a documented public demo resource.

resource.description: Exact resource URL the payment payload would carry (default: https://www.x402.org/)

network.description: CAIP-2 network, e.g. eip155:8453 for Base (default)

merchant_address.description: Optional payTo address for a merchant discovery lookup

also_retry_without_query.description: If the exact resource is not discovered, retry with the query string stripped (default false)
